rubric.role_summary: AI scientist researching and training foundation models for physics simulation, including simulation datasets, model architectures, and evaluation against engineering validation standards.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
AI scientist researching and training foundation models for physics simulation, including simulation datasets, model architectures, and evaluation against engineering validation standards.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- PhD or Master’s in CS/AI, an engineering science, or a related field.
- Hands-on machine learning expertise.
- Has developed ML methods for simulation or surrogate modelling.
- Python coding skills.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Industrial or academic experience with simulation solvers; listed solvers are examples, not individually required.
- Experience automating large-scale simulation campaigns on HPC clusters.
- Contributions to a large open-source or industry codebase.
- Publications in engineering or ML venues.
- Hands-on machine learning expertise encompassing model architectures, training dynamics, and evaluation methodology.
- Python coding skills and comfort working in Linux/HPC environments.
- Demonstrated success through industrial projects, academic work, or personal projects.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: Greater Paris, France area. Work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
